I know, it’s kind of s-scary!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Shouldn’t you two be out there mingling with everyone?
units.body: Shouldn’t you two be out there mingling with everyone?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Well actually, the detective and the journalist <style=Important>can’t be the murderer</style>.
units.body: Well actually, the detective and the journalist <style=Important>can’t be the murderer</style>.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: So we’re stuck here for an hour before going out and scoping the place.
units.body: So we’re stuck here for an hour before going out and scoping the place.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: This way there’s always a neutral party.
units.body: This way there’s always a neutral party.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Seems as though Amy’s more excited about deciphering the mystery anyways.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Seems as though Amy’s more excited about deciphering the mystery anyways.)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: What do you think everyone’s doing?
units.body: What do you think everyone’s doing?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Oh, probably inspecting their stations and talking amongst one another.
units.body: Oh, probably inspecting their stations and talking amongst one another.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Everyone has roles to play so they must be exploring their characters.
units.body: Everyone has roles to play so they must be exploring their characters.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Do you know what their character motivations are, Amy?
units.body: Do you know what their character motivations are, Amy?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: No, the lore cards are confidential! No one knows but the person who received them.
units.body: No, the lore cards are confidential! No one knows but the person who received them.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: My backstory is that I was best friends with a flicky that decided to join the evil Dr. Eggman, kickstarting my desire for justice in the world.
units.body: My backstory is that I was best friends with a flicky that decided to join the evil Dr. Eggman, kickstarting my desire for justice in the world.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: My lore is that I’m a nosey person turned journalist!
units.body: My lore is that I’m a nosey person turned journalist!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Not gonna lie, this kinda sounds fun!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Not gonna lie, this kinda sounds fun!)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Wish I wasn’t stuck on microwave duty.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Wish I wasn’t stuck on microwave duty.)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I-it’s so fast! Grab onto something!!
units.body: I-it’s so fast! Grab onto something!!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(All this stuff’s getting heavy… I’ll dump what I don’t need.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(All this stuff’s getting heavy… I’ll dump what I don’t need.)</style>

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Everyone’s favorite <style=Important>journalist reporter</style>, Amy Rose, is hot on the scoop!
units.body: Everyone’s favorite <style=Important>journalist reporter</style>, Amy Rose, is hot on the scoop!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I’m heading out, you’ve been fabulously helpful.
units.body: I’m heading out, you’ve been fabulously helpful.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Already? Before you go, Espio and I wanted to give you your <style=Important>presents</style>.
units.body: Already? Before you go, Espio and I wanted to give you your <style=Important>presents</style>.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: You’re both too sweet, thank you!
units.body: You’re both too sweet, thank you!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Hm… Vector, it seems we have more guests.
units.body: Hm… Vector, it seems we have more guests.
Have you found any leads yet?

units.original: ^Want to join us in finding clues?
units.body: Want to join us in finding clues?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Oh? The detective pair needs help from the birthday girl?
units.body: Oh? The detective pair needs help from the birthday girl?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Ah… she knows everyone’s allowed to be sassy on their birthday.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Ah… she knows everyone’s allowed to be sassy on their birthday.)</style>

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Flattered, but at the pace you two are going, Sonic’s murderer will never get found.
units.body: Flattered, but at the pace you two are going, Sonic’s murderer will never get found.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Oh, she’s confident. She must have something up her sleeve.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Oh, she’s confident. She must have something up her sleeve.)</style>

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: This tip is just too juicy to ignore, I’ll see you all around!
units.body: This tip is just too juicy to ignore, I’ll see you all around!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Don’t worry Sonic, I’ll be the one to avenge you. And quick!
units.body: Don’t worry Sonic, I’ll be the one to avenge you. And quick!

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: But how are you gonna leave? The door to the next car is locked!
units.body: But how are you gonna leave? The door to the next car is locked!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Oh, you doubt the birthday girl?
units.body: Oh, you doubt the birthday girl?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: The birthday girl has a master key!
units.body: The birthday girl has a master key!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Right right, the birthday girl gets the birthday key.
units.body: Right right, the birthday girl gets the birthday key.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Of course, it’s a birthday privilege.
units.body: Of course, it’s a birthday privilege.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I'll solve this case before anyone else! Byeee!
units.body: I'll solve this case before anyone else! Byeee!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Amy may be hasty, but she’s thorough.
units.body: Amy may be hasty, but she’s thorough.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Now, what are you two doin’? Lookin’ mighty suspicious I say!
units.body: Now, what are you two doin’? Lookin’ mighty suspicious I say!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I’m the <style=Important>detective</style>, so I <style=Important>can’t be the murderer</style>.
units.body: I’m the <style=Important>detective</style>, so I <style=Important>can’t be the murderer</style>.
Just making sure things go well.
Here to ask if anyone’s hungry.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Not sure if you’ve forgotten, but there was a murder.
units.body: Not sure if you’ve forgotten, but there was a murder.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Starved! I’d kill for a chicken parmesan right about now.
units.body: Starved! I’d kill for a chicken parmesan right about now.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Maybe ‘kill’ isn’t the right language to use right now…
units.body: Maybe ‘kill’ isn’t the right language to use right now…

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: I’m Vector, the <style=Important>butcher</style>. I’m licensed to handle raw meat!
units.body: I’m Vector, the <style=Important>butcher</style>. I’m licensed to handle raw meat!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Ah, poetry! A resonant message from poet to reader meant to challenge our delicate perspectives with the most rhythmic of prose.
units.body: Ah, poetry! A resonant message from poet to reader meant to challenge our delicate perspectives with the most rhythmic of prose.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original:
^Espio:: Teardrops in the spring,
Can you hear me sing?
La la la la, dee dee dee dee.
units.body:
Teardrops in the spring,
Can you hear me sing?
La la la la, dee dee dee dee.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I have more if you like.
units.body: I have more if you like.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I’m, uh, satisfied for now, thanks.
units.body: I’m, uh, satisfied for now, thanks.

units.original: ^ and I are here to establish both of your alibis.
units.body: and I are here to establish both of your alibis.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Can you walk us through what happened after Amy had everyone leave the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?
units.body: Can you walk us through what happened after Amy had everyone leave the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Oh sure, it’s simple! We just explained this to Amy, actually.
units.body: Oh sure, it’s simple! We just explained this to Amy, actually.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: When we were all sent off, Rouge, Blaze, Shadow, and Sonic all passed through this <style=CarName>library car</style>,
units.body: When we were all sent off, Rouge, Blaze, Shadow, and Sonic all passed through this <style=CarName>library car</style>,

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: ...where Amy told me and Espio to stay.
units.body: ...where Amy told me and Espio to stay.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I promptly picked a book off the shelf and made myself comfortable.
units.body: I promptly picked a book off the shelf and made myself comfortable.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Vector got bored, so he left to see what Knuckles was up to in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
units.body: Vector got bored, so he left to see what Knuckles was up to in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Where was Rouge? We happened to see her lipstick stain on a cup at the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
units.body: Where was Rouge? We happened to see her lipstick stain on a cup at the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Rouge came over to the <style=CarName>library car</style>, seemingly looking for something.
units.body: Rouge came over to the <style=CarName>library car</style>, seemingly looking for something.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Then she went to search the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
units.body: Then she went to search the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: She came back shortly after. We heard her shout “NO WAY” at the brochure stand over there-
units.body: She came back shortly after. We heard her shout “NO WAY” at the brochure stand over there-

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: But she left back to the <style=CarName>casino car</style> before Shadow came through and locked the door.
units.body: But she left back to the <style=CarName>casino car</style> before Shadow came through and locked the door.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Wonder what she found? She’s obviously been on the hunt for something…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Wonder what she found? She’s obviously been on the hunt for something…)</style>

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: After Rouge left, Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>casino car</style>...
units.body: After Rouge left, Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>casino car</style>...

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Then entered the <style=CarName>library car</style> and locked the door behind him.
units.body: Then entered the <style=CarName>library car</style> and locked the door behind him.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(More importantly… Why has Shadow been locking doors?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(More importantly… Why has Shadow been locking doors?)</style>

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, where Knuckles and I were playing games.
units.body: Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, where Knuckles and I were playing games.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: He insisted on showing us up at Super Monkey Ball.
units.body: He insisted on showing us up at Super Monkey Ball.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: I got so engrossed by the rolling monkey action, I hardly noticed when Shadow left the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>...
units.body: I got so engrossed by the rolling monkey action, I hardly noticed when Shadow left the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>...

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: ...I guess he walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to the <style=CarName>casino car</style>, again locking the door behind him...
units.body: ...I guess he walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to the <style=CarName>casino car</style>, again locking the door behind him...

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: ...then returned to the <style=CarName>lounge car</style> where he was meant to be stationed.
units.body: ...then returned to the <style=CarName>lounge car</style> where he was meant to be stationed.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: When Vector came back, we realized Knuckles locked the door to the  <style=CarName>saloon car</style>. We were stuck in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
units.body: When Vector came back, we realized Knuckles locked the door to the  <style=CarName>saloon car</style>. We were stuck in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: That’s when  the train sped up! We were worried about the bookshelves falling on us, but we got through it alright.
units.body: That’s when  the train sped up! We were worried about the bookshelves falling on us, but we got through it alright.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: We sat trapped here until Amy arrived asking questions. She’s the one that told us someone murdered Sonic.
units.body: We sat trapped here until Amy arrived asking questions. She’s the one that told us someone murdered Sonic.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: And, yeah. That’s all that happened.
units.body: And, yeah. That’s all that happened.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Hmm… with all these locked doors, it seems Vector or Espio couldn't have left the <style=CarName>library car</style> or the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Hmm… with all these locked doors, it seems Vector or Espio couldn't have left the <style=CarName>library car</style> or the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>…)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Thank you both for your cooperation! We’re just gonna peek around, and we’ll return with any questions.
units.body: Thank you both for your cooperation! We’re just gonna peek around, and we’ll return with any questions.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: If you return with any meat, I’ll chop it up for yah!
units.body: If you return with any meat, I’ll chop it up for yah!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: And if you’d like to be serenaded with a poem, I got you covered too.
units.body: And if you’d like to be serenaded with a poem, I got you covered too.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Their alibi’s seem solid enough, but we should still search for clues.
units.body: Their alibi’s seem solid enough, but we should still search for clues.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: What we’re looking for is any evidence that <style=Important>proves what they’re saying is true</style>.
units.body: What we’re looking for is any evidence that <style=Important>proves what they’re saying is true</style>.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(We need to confirm Vector’s reason for leaving his post, and determine if Espio was actually in the <style=CarName>library car</style> reading.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(We need to confirm Vector’s reason for leaving his post, and determine if Espio was actually in the <style=CarName>library car</style> reading.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(A tall task, but we can do it!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(A tall task, but we can do it!)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Let’s get to the bottom of this, Tails!
units.body: Let’s get to the bottom of this, Tails!

units.original: ^Can I get a poem about space?
units.body: Can I get a poem about space?
How about a poem about trains?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original:
^Espio:: I’ve made it up to space
With my beloved antique vase
But a mistake in my haste
Dropped the vase from my embrace
So my antique I must now replace.
units.body:
I’ve made it up to space
With my beloved antique vase
But a mistake in my haste
Dropped the vase from my embrace
So my antique I must now replace.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: What caused you to drop the vase?
units.body: What caused you to drop the vase?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Don’t read too deeply, it’s just a poem.
units.body: Don’t read too deeply, it’s just a poem.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...he hasn’t thought it through, has he.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...he hasn’t thought it through, has he.)</style>

units.speaker: Espio
units.original:
^Espio:: Locomotive, in motion
I think I lost my lotion
The window shows the ocean
Oh wait, there’s my lotion
units.body:
Locomotive, in motion
I think I lost my lotion
The window shows the ocean
Oh wait, there’s my lotion

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I actually really liked that one.
units.body: I actually really liked that one.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Hmm... I don't think we have enough evidence yet.
units.body: Hmm... I don't think we have enough evidence yet.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Why don't we look around a little more first?
units.body: Why don't we look around a little more first?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I have a poem about this.
units.body: I have a poem about this.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original:
^Espio:: My starved stomach babbled,
Though I ignore the grumbling tummy.
For the eggs I received are scrambled,
When I asked for my eggs sunny.
units.body:
My starved stomach babbled,
Though I ignore the grumbling tummy.
For the eggs I received are scrambled,
When I asked for my eggs sunny.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Oh wow, um. We don’t serve any eggs on the train, though.
units.body: Oh wow, um. We don’t serve any eggs on the train, though.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: My talent is wasted on you lot.
units.body: My talent is wasted on you lot.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: <style="Italics">May the breeze drift you towards success.</style>
units.body: <style="Italics">May the breeze drift you towards success.</style>

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: A one sentence poem for you.
units.body: A one sentence poem for you.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...are italics enough to qualify as a poem?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...are italics enough to qualify as a poem?)</style>

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Did you bring me any meat to chop?
units.body: Did you bring me any meat to chop?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Hmm... I don't think we have enough evidence yet
units.body: Hmm... I don't think we have enough evidence yet

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Why don't we look around a little more first?
units.body: Why don't we look around a little more first?

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Nothing like cold cuts for a cold case. Let me know if you need any good butcherin'!
units.body: Nothing like cold cuts for a cold case. Let me know if you need any good butcherin'!

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: I may be a butcher, but they confiscated my meat cleaver before getting on the train…
units.body: I may be a butcher, but they confiscated my meat cleaver before getting on the train…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: You actually tried to bring a knife on the train??
units.body: You actually tried to bring a knife on the train??

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: I’m a man of authenticity, Tails. Without a knife I’m just a chef in a ketchup-stained apron, not a butcher!
units.body: I’m a man of authenticity, Tails. Without a knife I’m just a chef in a ketchup-stained apron, not a butcher!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: I think if you had a knife on you, we’d definitely think you were the murderer.
units.body: I think if you had a knife on you, we’d definitely think you were the murderer.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: …hm. But what if I hid the knife?
units.body: …hm. But what if I hid the knife?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Y’know, I’m not the biggest fan of this line of thought.
units.body: Y’know, I’m not the biggest fan of this line of thought.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Actually I’m off duty at the moment, the murder mystery is more important.
units.body: Actually I’m off duty at the moment, the murder mystery is more important.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: …then why would you show the menu to me?
units.body: …then why would you show the menu to me?

units.original: ^, why would you tease him like that?
units.body: , why would you tease him like that?

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: And here I thought I could trust you. You’ve made a fool of me..
units.body: And here I thought I could trust you. You’ve made a fool of me..

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...I smoothed things over, but at what cost.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...I smoothed things over, but at what cost.)</style>

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Bring me any meat to slice up?
units.body: Bring me any meat to slice up?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: No, I’m not sure we will actually!
units.body: No, I’m not sure we will actually!

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: So! The two of you don’t believe us, eh?
units.body: So! The two of you don’t believe us, eh?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: It’s not that I don’t trust either of you, but I wouldn’t be a proper detective without examining the validity of your alibis.
units.body: It’s not that I don’t trust either of you, but I wouldn’t be a proper detective without examining the validity of your alibis.

units.original: ^ and I are here to confirm two things-
units.body: and I are here to confirm two things-

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Why Vector left to go play games with Knuckles, and if Espio really was reading in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
units.body: Why Vector left to go play games with Knuckles, and if Espio really was reading in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Vector, we’ll start with you. Why did you leave the <style=CarName>library car</style> to visit Knuckles? We’re prepared to present evidence if nee–
units.body: Vector, we’ll start with you. Why did you leave the <style=CarName>library car</style> to visit Knuckles? We’re prepared to present evidence if nee–

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Oh that’s easy, I got bored.
units.body: Oh that’s easy, I got bored.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I wasn’t entertaining him enough, it seems. Vector enjoys being social.
units.body: I wasn’t entertaining him enough, it seems. Vector enjoys being social.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Plus we were instructed to mingle. I remembered the arcade machine in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, so figured I’d go check it out.
units.body: Plus we were instructed to mingle. I remembered the arcade machine in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, so figured I’d go check it out.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(This seems to line up with the information we gathered with Knuckles.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(This seems to line up with the information we gathered with Knuckles.)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Then that brings our attention to you, Espio. Rouge entered the <style=CarName>library car</style>, found something, then left.
units.body: Then that brings our attention to you, Espio. Rouge entered the <style=CarName>library car</style>, found something, then left.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: You said you immediately started reading, but were you actually reading the entire time you were in the <style=CarName>library car</style>?
units.body: You said you immediately started reading, but were you actually reading the entire time you were in the <style=CarName>library car</style>?

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Once Espio starts reading, he doesn’t stop till it’s done! I’ve seen it happen.
units.body: Once Espio starts reading, he doesn’t stop till it’s done! I’ve seen it happen.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: It must have been a good read! What was the book?
units.body: It must have been a good read! What was the book?

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Espio doesn’t owe you that, ‘detective!’ Let the man live.
units.body: Espio doesn’t owe you that, ‘detective!’ Let the man live.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: What kind of things do you think I read?
units.body: What kind of things do you think I read?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: If you won’t talk, I have a hunch on what that book might be.
units.body: If you won’t talk, I have a hunch on what that book might be.

units.original: ^, what book do we think Espio may have been reading?)</style>
units.body: , what book do we think Espio may have been reading?)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Hmm, I’m not quite sure this is right. Let's look for more evidence.
units.body: Hmm, I’m not quite sure this is right. Let's look for more evidence.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: A manual?? You think Espio was reading instructions?
units.body: A manual?? You think Espio was reading instructions?

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: What argument could you possibly have to support this??
units.body: What argument could you possibly have to support this??

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Seems like that was the wrong choice. What book could Espio have been reading?
units.body: Seems like that was the wrong choice. What book could Espio have been reading?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: There are books scattered around the floor sure, but the remaining books on the shelves were all in <style=Important>alphabetical order</style>.
units.body: There are books scattered around the floor sure, but the remaining books on the shelves were all in <style=Important>alphabetical order</style>.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …all except, this manual. Meaning someone, at the very least, picked the manual up and put it back in the incorrect place.
units.body: …all except, this manual. Meaning someone, at the very least, picked the manual up and put it back in the incorrect place.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: This lack of attention to detail isn’t normally like you, Espio.
units.body: This lack of attention to detail isn’t normally like you, Espio.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Hey now! I won’t have you insulting my pal like thi–
units.body: Hey now! I won’t have you insulting my pal like thi–

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Calm down, Vector. I know you mean well but… I can handle myself.
units.body: Calm down, Vector. I know you mean well but… I can handle myself.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(A butcher and a poet, friendship can form anywhere.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(A butcher and a poet, friendship can form anywhere.)</style>

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: That is indeed the book I was reading. <style=InventoryItem>The Mirage Express Manual</style>. Trains are cool.
units.body: That is indeed the book I was reading. <style=InventoryItem>The Mirage Express Manual</style>. Trains are cool.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: In that case, we’d like to ask you a few questions about the manual.
units.body: In that case, we’d like to ask you a few questions about the manual.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Could you ask Espio some questions about the manual? Just flip to a page and ask away!
units.body: Could you ask Espio some questions about the manual? Just flip to a page and ask away!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Oh I see, quiz Espio about the manual to prove he read it…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Oh I see, quiz Espio about the manual to prove he read it…)</style>

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: You were both grasping, I knew it!
units.body: You were both grasping, I knew it!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Which page should I quiz him on?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Which page should I quiz him on?)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Ok, um, what efficient and extremely accurate technology was installed to assist in keeping the train spotless?
units.body: Ok, um, what efficient and extremely accurate technology was installed to assist in keeping the train spotless?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: <style=Important>Robotic Arms</style>. During events they can perform a variety of tasks, and are responsible for cleaning up trash and messes afterwards.
units.body: <style=Important>Robotic Arms</style>. During events they can perform a variety of tasks, and are responsible for cleaning up trash and messes afterwards.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(I remember the conductor saying the train can clean itself.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(I remember the conductor saying the train can clean itself.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Though, I have a feeling the train company just didn’t want to hire any janitors…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Though, I have a feeling the train company just didn’t want to hire any janitors…)</style>

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: The <style=Important>robotic arms</style> can also detect weapons or explosives being brought onto the train, ensuring passenger safety.
units.body: The <style=Important>robotic arms</style> can also detect weapons or explosives being brought onto the train, ensuring passenger safety.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Seems like Espio aced that question!
units.body: Seems like Espio aced that question!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Oh, ok! Which page do I choose?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Oh, ok! Which page do I choose?)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: What is the <style=Important>Mirage Express</style>’s cancellation policy?
units.body: What is the <style=Important>Mirage Express</style>’s cancellation policy?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: No refunds and you will be charged a no show fee. This does not apply if you’re over the age of 65.
units.body: No refunds and you will be charged a no show fee. This does not apply if you’re over the age of 65.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Gee, the person who made this rule must have been over 65.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Gee, the person who made this rule must have been over 65.)</style>

units.original: ^, let’s see if Espio can go three for three.
units.body: , let’s see if Espio can go three for three.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Gotcha, which page should I pick last?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Gotcha, which page should I pick last?)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: What was implemented to support the conductor duties and ease general train obligations?
units.body: What was implemented to support the conductor duties and ease general train obligations?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: An intelligent  data processing system. It works in tandem with the conductor to assure smooth travel for guests.
units.body: An intelligent  data processing system. It works in tandem with the conductor to assure smooth travel for guests.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(I remember this. The train has an autopilot, but it can’t access its full suite of capabilities without the conductor present.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(I remember this. The train has an autopilot, but it can’t access its full suite of capabilities without the conductor present.)</style>

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Now, did I pass your little test?
units.body: Now, did I pass your little test?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Totally! It’s wild you were able to retain all this information so quickly.
units.body: Totally! It’s wild you were able to retain all this information so quickly.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: A poet’s brain is often surprising.
units.body: A poet’s brain is often surprising.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...I don’t know if I’d be bragging about that.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...I don’t know if I’d be bragging about that.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: I hate to say it, but no.
units.body: I hate to say it, but no.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original:
^Espio:: I completed your test with ease,
All my efforts were only to please.
But you joked and japed,
Said no to my face,
Now I wish you were riddled with fleas.
units.body:
I completed your test with ease,
All my efforts were only to please.
But you joked and japed,
Said no to my face,
Now I wish you were riddled with fleas.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...did he just rhyme a curse at me?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...did he just rhyme a curse at me?)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: You’ve clearly read the manual, those answers feel far too specific to be guesses.
units.body: You’ve clearly read the manual, those answers feel far too specific to be guesses.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: And you both had the nerve to question my buddy like that.
units.body: And you both had the nerve to question my buddy like that.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Don’t we want to be supportin’ folks who read??
units.body: Don’t we want to be supportin’ folks who read??

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: You have to admit though, reading the entire time a murder occurred does sound a bit suspicious, even if true.
units.body: You have to admit though, reading the entire time a murder occurred does sound a bit suspicious, even if true.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(But he answered all my questions so calmly… that’s very impressive.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(But he answered all my questions so calmly… that’s very impressive.)</style>

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: No no, I understand everyone’s cautious attitudes.
units.body: No no, I understand everyone’s cautious attitudes.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Vector was the only one to see me reading after all. My alibi is hard to substantiate despite being the truth.
units.body: Vector was the only one to see me reading after all. My alibi is hard to substantiate despite being the truth.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Well you definitely read through the manual, so I suppose we ca–
units.body: Well you definitely read through the manual, so I suppose we ca–

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Espio, is that true? Vector was the only one to see you reading?
units.body: Espio, is that true? Vector was the only one to see you reading?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Frankly… I don’t believe that can be true. And we have evidence to back it up.
units.body: Frankly… I don’t believe that can be true. And we have evidence to back it up.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: …! <style=Thought>(He always puts me on the spot!)</style>
units.body: …! <style=Thought>(He always puts me on the spot!)</style>

units.original: ^, think. We should have a piece of evidence linked to someone who also saw Espio reading. But what?)</style>
units.body: , think. We should have a piece of evidence linked to someone who also saw Espio reading. But what?)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Hmm, I’m not quite sure this is right. Let's look for more evidence.
units.body: Hmm, I’m not quite sure this is right. Let's look for more evidence.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Please, pray tell, what this has to do with anything?
units.body: Please, pray tell, what this has to do with anything?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Not sure what you’re trying to say with that. Don’t waste my time.
units.body: Not sure what you’re trying to say with that. Don’t waste my time.

units.original: ^. What evidence do we have that shows someone else should have seen Espio reading?
units.body: . What evidence do we have that shows someone else should have seen Espio reading?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to get to the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, where he set the original high score on the arcade machine.
units.body: Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to get to the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, where he set the original high score on the arcade machine.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Yeah, but I ended up beating it! It wasn’t the high score long!
units.body: Yeah, but I ended up beating it! It wasn’t the high score long!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Espio said he saw Shadow enter the <style=CarName>library car</style>… but he’s mentioned nothing about Shadow’s return.
units.body: Espio said he saw Shadow enter the <style=CarName>library car</style>… but he’s mentioned nothing about Shadow’s return.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: He only mentions that Vector came back.
units.body: He only mentions that Vector came back.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: When Shadow left Knuckles and Vector in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, Espio was fully seated reading his book for a good while at this point.
units.body: When Shadow left Knuckles and Vector in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, Espio was fully seated reading his book for a good while at this point.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: We know Shadow had to walk back through the <style=CarName>library car</style> when he left the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>…
units.body: We know Shadow had to walk back through the <style=CarName>library car</style> when he left the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: So there’s absolutely no way Shadow and Espio didn’t notice one another on Shadow’s return trip!
units.body: So there’s absolutely no way Shadow and Espio didn’t notice one another on Shadow’s return trip!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Ah... I mean, it was a simple slip up–
units.body: Ah... I mean, it was a simple slip up–

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I was just– fully immersed in my book that I didn’t notice Shadow!
units.body: I was just– fully immersed in my book that I didn’t notice Shadow!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: You’re telling me the sound of doors opening and locking wouldn’t have caused you to look up?
units.body: You’re telling me the sound of doors opening and locking wouldn’t have caused you to look up?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(I can sense Espio’s desperation here… defending the argument that he was reading the entire time isn’t easy.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(I can sense Espio’s desperation here… defending the argument that he was reading the entire time isn’t easy.)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: So if you didn’t see Shadow returning from the <style=CarName>saloon car</style> to lock all the doors…
units.body: So if you didn’t see Shadow returning from the <style=CarName>saloon car</style> to lock all the doors…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …then, at that moment, were you really in the <style=CarName>library car</style> at all?
units.body: …then, at that moment, were you really in the <style=CarName>library car</style> at all?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: …! But how would Espio leave? Shadow locked all the doors and no one saw Espio in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>!
units.body: …! But how would Espio leave? Shadow locked all the doors and no one saw Espio in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>!

units.original: ^, one that I would love for Espio to solve.
units.body: , one that I would love for Espio to solve.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I was so involved with my book I didn’t notice Shadow pass back through the <style=CarName>library car</style>, honest!
units.body: I was so involved with my book I didn’t notice Shadow pass back through the <style=CarName>library car</style>, honest!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: When Vector returned, he even had to tap me on the shoulder to get my attention!
units.body: When Vector returned, he even had to tap me on the shoulder to get my attention!

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Yeah! I think I remember doing that!
units.body: Yeah! I think I remember doing that!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I must avenge my friend’s death, so I’ll ask you again, Espio.
units.body: I must avenge my friend’s death, so I’ll ask you again, Espio.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: If you weren’t there for Shadow to see you reading, then how did you leave the <style=CarName>library car</style>?
units.body: If you weren’t there for Shadow to see you reading, then how did you leave the <style=CarName>library car</style>?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Why doesn’t this seem right to me? Tails definitely feels like he’s on to something, but I don’t see it.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Why doesn’t this seem right to me? Tails definitely feels like he’s on to something, but I don’t see it.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Was Espio simply sitting reading, or did he somehow vanish to not notice Shadow’s return to the <style=CarName>library car</style>?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Was Espio simply sitting reading, or did he somehow vanish to not notice Shadow’s return to the <style=CarName>library car</style>?)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(No, I can’t interrupt Tails while he’s on to something.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(No, I can’t interrupt Tails while he’s on to something.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(I’ll let him continue this line of questioning and–)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(I’ll let him continue this line of questioning and–)</style>

units.original: ^, my favorite and beloved employee… please…
units.body: , my favorite and beloved employee… please…

units.speaker: Conductor
units.original: ^Conductor:: Protect the passengers aboard this train… they must be taken care of!
units.body: Protect the passengers aboard this train… they must be taken care of!

units.speaker: Conductor
units.original: ^Conductor:: If you fail, the lawsuits will be torturous! Don’t allow such an old, feeble soul to get sued.
units.body: If you fail, the lawsuits will be torturous! Don’t allow such an old, feeble soul to get sued.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...I have to make sure our guests are taken care of. I have to speak up!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...I have to make sure our guests are taken care of. I have to speak up!)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: We have a piece of evidence that can answer all of our problems.
units.body: We have a piece of evidence that can answer all of our problems.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …Alright my fellow associate, lay it on me!
units.body: …Alright my fellow associate, lay it on me!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: What piece of evidence shows Shadow and Espio couldn’t have seen one another?
units.body: What piece of evidence shows Shadow and Espio couldn’t have seen one another?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Hmm, this doesn’t feel quite right. Let's look for more evidence.
units.body: Hmm, this doesn’t feel quite right. Let's look for more evidence.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Alright! Now let's get my thoughts in order…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Alright! Now let's get my thoughts in order…)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(When Shadow returned to the <style=CarName>library car</style>, Espio and Shadow didn’t see each other. What piece of evidence helps explain that?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(When Shadow returned to the <style=CarName>library car</style>, Espio and Shadow didn’t see each other. What piece of evidence helps explain that?)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: See the exits? They’re right across from one another, a straight path.
units.body: See the exits? They’re right across from one another, a straight path.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: If Shadow walked down this straight path, there’s a way Espio and Shadow couldn’t have seen one another.
units.body: If Shadow walked down this straight path, there’s a way Espio and Shadow couldn’t have seen one another.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Looks like you’ll have to point out where exactly on the map you mean.
units.body: Looks like you’ll have to point out where exactly on the map you mean.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Where could Espio have been for Shadow to not see him?
units.body: Where could Espio have been for Shadow to not see him?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: That desk is huge! I'm sure Shadow would've seen Espio if he was reading there.
units.body: That desk is huge! I'm sure Shadow would've seen Espio if he was reading there.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: That's a bookcase. I think Shadow would've noticed if Espio was climbing one of those while he walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
units.body: That's a bookcase. I think Shadow would've noticed if Espio was climbing one of those while he walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style>.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(For Shadow to not see Espio as he was walking through the <style=CarName>library car</style>, where would Espio have been seated?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(For Shadow to not see Espio as he was walking through the <style=CarName>library car</style>, where would Espio have been seated?)</style>

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Interesting. That’s where I was sitting reading my book.
units.body: Interesting. That’s where I was sitting reading my book.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: I can second this! When I returned from the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, Espio was in the same spot.
units.body: I can second this! When I returned from the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, Espio was in the same spot.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: That confirms it, then. You see, Shadow and Espio couldn’t have seen one another from this spot…
units.body: That confirms it, then. You see, Shadow and Espio couldn’t have seen one another from this spot…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Because a bookcase is in the way!
units.body: Because a bookcase is in the way!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: There’s no way Shadow could have seen Espio, or vice versa!
units.body: There’s no way Shadow could have seen Espio, or vice versa!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: It makes a lot of sense why you never mentioned Shadow’s return, Espio.
units.body: It makes a lot of sense why you never mentioned Shadow’s return, Espio.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: There’s just no way you would have seen him.
units.body: There’s just no way you would have seen him.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I apologize for losing my cool back there. I felt like I was grasping despite telling the truth.
units.body: I apologize for losing my cool back there. I felt like I was grasping despite telling the truth.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: But I’m glad you all believe me now.
units.body: But I’m glad you all believe me now.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Your alibi isn’t the most airtight, but I have no further points.
units.body: Your alibi isn’t the most airtight, but I have no further points.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Thank you both for answering all our questions!
units.body: Thank you both for answering all our questions!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(W-we did it! Another pair of alibi’s, validated!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(W-we did it! Another pair of alibi’s, validated!)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Too many locked doors to worry about, but I’m glad everything straightened itself out in the end)</style>.
units.body: <style=Thought>(Too many locked doors to worry about, but I’m glad everything straightened itself out in the end)</style>.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Well, I’m exhausted! I’m gonna crash here for a bit, these chairs are so comfy.
units.body: Well, I’m exhausted! I’m gonna crash here for a bit, these chairs are so comfy.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Likewise… I could use a breather.
units.body: Likewise… I could use a breather.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Sadly our work isn’t done! I have plenty of questions for Rouge, and especially Shadow.
units.body: Sadly our work isn’t done! I have plenty of questions for Rouge, and especially Shadow.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Oh? It seems the door to the next car is open.
units.body: Oh? It seems the door to the next car is open.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Amy must’ve kept it open when she passed through earlier.
units.body: Amy must’ve kept it open when she passed through earlier.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Then that’s our cue to leave! See you later, Vector and Espio.
units.body: Then that’s our cue to leave! See you later, Vector and Espio.

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Give em’ heck! And if you need any meat chopped up, say the word!
units.body: Give em’ heck! And if you need any meat chopped up, say the word!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I’ll keep my poetry sharp for you both.
units.body: I’ll keep my poetry sharp for you both.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original:
^Espio:: A murderer is on the loose,
While doors keep getting locked.
Tick tick tock goes the clock,
While our heroes are in the caboose.
units.body:
A murderer is on the loose,
While doors keep getting locked.
Tick tick tock goes the clock,
While our heroes are in the caboose.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(At this point, I’m feeling pretty confident in our detective abilities. We’re really doing this…!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(At this point, I’m feeling pretty confident in our detective abilities. We’re really doing this…!)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: So many books on the ground… I wish we had time to pick them all up.
units.body: So many books on the ground… I wish we had time to pick them all up.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: I sadly have no interest in picking up these books.
units.body: I sadly have no interest in picking up these books.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: A lot of these were knocked out by the train speeding up…
units.body: A lot of these were knocked out by the train speeding up…

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: But Rouge pulled a lot of these out too searching for something.

Tie them into one big knot
