units.original: ^Tails:: We appreciate you answering our questions, Rouge. You take care now.
units.body: We appreciate you answering our questions, Rouge. You take care now.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Can I interest you to anything on the menu?
units.body: Can I interest you to anything on the menu?

units.speaker: Blaze
units.original: ^Blaze:: I’m content for now, thank you.
units.body: I’m content for now, thank you.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.original: ^Blaze:: The whole “maybe the egg is a bomb” thing destroyed my appetite.
units.body: The whole “maybe the egg is a bomb” thing destroyed my appetite.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Haha, yeah… I was nervous myself.
units.body: Haha, yeah… I was nervous myself.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: We could tell. You sweat out of your uniform pretty often.
units.body: We could tell. You sweat out of your uniform pretty often.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.original: ^Blaze:: Yeah, you're a very um… animated person.
units.body: Yeah, you're a very um… animated person.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.original: ^Rouge:: What a paltry menu. Not a lot of options, sweetie.
units.body: What a paltry menu. Not a lot of options, sweetie.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.original: ^Rouge:: I think I’ll have to pass.
units.body: I think I’ll have to pass.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Not a problem, just let me know if you need something later.
units.body: Not a problem, just let me know if you need something later.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.original: ^Rouge:: Sure, if I need a bag of chips I’ll holler.
units.body: Sure, if I need a bag of chips I’ll holler.
Maybe after a few more games

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Don't let this unsolved murder slow you down...
units.body: Don't let this unsolved murder slow you down...

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Now is as good a time as any to clean out my pockets…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Now is as good a time as any to clean out my pockets…)</style>

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I know you won’t talk, but I know exactly why you’ve been locking those doors!
units.body: I know you won’t talk, but I know exactly why you’ve been locking those doors!

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: It’s hard to get a word in as you talk over me.
units.body: It’s hard to get a word in as you talk over me.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: No reason is convincing enough! It’s inconceivable what you did!
units.body: No reason is convincing enough! It’s inconceivable what you did!

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: …hmph. I see you made it here, Tails.
units.body: …hmph. I see you made it here, Tails.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: But I didn’t expect the iron chef as well.
units.body: But I didn’t expect the iron chef as well.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(We’ll see what you say when your microwave chili dog’s delicious.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(We’ll see what you say when your microwave chili dog’s delicious.)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I’d also like to know why you’ve been locking doors throughout the train, Shadow.
units.body: I’d also like to know why you’ve been locking doors throughout the train, Shadow.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: Well it seems Amy already knows, so ask her.
units.body: Well it seems Amy already knows, so ask her.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: I’m not saying a thing, you lot will have to tell me why.
units.body: I’m not saying a thing, you lot will have to tell me why.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: Now if you could leave me be, I have an appointment coming up.
units.body: Now if you could leave me be, I have an appointment coming up.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(An appointment? Who wants to meet with him?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(An appointment? Who wants to meet with him?)</style>

units.original: ^, it seems like Shadow isn’t gonna talk. Let’s do some investigating!
units.body: , it seems like Shadow isn’t gonna talk. Let’s do some investigating!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Alright! Ready to find some answers, Tails?
units.body: Alright! Ready to find some answers, Tails?

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: Why did you come over here?
units.body: Why did you come over here?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Hmm... I don't think we have enough evidence yet
units.body: Hmm... I don't think we have enough evidence yet

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Why don't we look around a little more first?
units.body: Why don't we look around a little more first?

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: There’s nothing I can help either of you with. I ask that you leave me be.
units.body: There’s nothing I can help either of you with. I ask that you leave me be.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Y’know, maybe we will get out of here actually.
units.body: Y’know, maybe we will get out of here actually.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: I can’t believe a secret passage was here this whole time…
units.body: I can’t believe a secret passage was here this whole time…

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: That would have been very useful.
units.body: That would have been very useful.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Yeah, the library is closest to the bathroom, it would have been really convenient!
units.body: Yeah, the library is closest to the bathroom, it would have been really convenient!

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: I’ll take you up on that coffee.
units.body: I’ll take you up on that coffee.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: When I’m back in the <style=CarName>dining car</style> I’ll whip that right up!
units.body: When I’m back in the <style=CarName>dining car</style> I’ll whip that right up!

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: A coffee on a train… there’s no better combination.
units.body: A coffee on a train… there’s no better combination.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Some marshmallows would make it perfect.
units.body: Some marshmallows would make it perfect.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(It took every muscle in his body to agree with Tails.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(It took every muscle in his body to agree with Tails.)</style>

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Glad you two finally caught up!
units.body: Glad you two finally caught up!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I'm so close to getting the scoop of the century, I can feel it!
units.body: I'm so close to getting the scoop of the century, I can feel it!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Oh? A question for moi? You know the <style=Important>journalist can't be the murderer</style>, remember?
units.body: Oh? A question for moi? You know the <style=Important>journalist can't be the murderer</style>, remember?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: We’ve learned the train will confiscate any weapons brought on board…
units.body: We’ve learned the train will confiscate any weapons brought on board…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …but you’ve had your hammer this whole time.
units.body: …but you’ve had your hammer this whole time.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Simple, the birthday girl gets what the birthday girl wants.
units.body: Simple, the birthday girl gets what the birthday girl wants.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: And I don’t go anywhere without my hammer!
units.body: And I don’t go anywhere without my hammer!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Ah, birthday law, we should have known.
units.body: Ah, birthday law, we should have known.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Everyone knows the birthday rules! Makes sense to me!
units.body: Everyone knows the birthday rules! Makes sense to me!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Now, no more questions! When you’re ready to challenge Shadow, talk to him. I’ll be ready.
units.body: Now, no more questions! When you’re ready to challenge Shadow, talk to him. I’ll be ready.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I'm surprised it took you so long to get here, I thought you wanted to save Sonic.
units.body: I'm surprised it took you so long to get here, I thought you wanted to save Sonic.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: We’ve been thorough! Do you have any clues for us?
units.body: We’ve been thorough! Do you have any clues for us?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Just a hot tip, but all will be revealed in due time.
units.body: Just a hot tip, but all will be revealed in due time.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I think I’ll be shedding a big light on this whole case!
units.body: I think I’ll be shedding a big light on this whole case!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: No way! Journalist reporter Amy Rose is always first to reveal a scoop.
units.body: No way! Journalist reporter Amy Rose is always first to reveal a scoop.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: When you’re ready to challenge Shadow, talk to him. Then I’ll be ready.
units.body: When you’re ready to challenge Shadow, talk to him. Then I’ll be ready.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(I’m so curious what it is… she seems confident.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(I’m so curious what it is… she seems confident.)</style>

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I wonder what we’ll find there.
units.body: I wonder what we’ll find there.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Admittedly I haven’t seen the conductor in awhile… hope he’s alright.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Admittedly I haven’t seen the conductor in awhile… hope he’s alright.)</style>

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I’m not ordering a single thing till we get birthday cake.
units.body: I’m not ordering a single thing till we get birthday cake.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Cake first, dinner after. Otherwise I’ll get full on dinner and can’t have any cake!
units.body: Cake first, dinner after. Otherwise I’ll get full on dinner and can’t have any cake!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: You have priorities, I respect that.
units.body: You have priorities, I respect that.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Shadow, we have questions for you.
units.body: Shadow, we have questions for you.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: Will you three get out? I’m busy.
units.body: Will you three get out? I’m busy.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: As I said, I have an appointment to attend to.
units.body: As I said, I have an appointment to attend to.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Shadow, we’ve questioned everyone on this train, and every single person has mentioned running into you.
units.body: Shadow, we’ve questioned everyone on this train, and every single person has mentioned running into you.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: You’ve been locking every door in this train, and–
units.body: You’ve been locking every door in this train, and–

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: …pray tell, why was I locking all the doors?
units.body: …pray tell, why was I locking all the doors?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Heheh, time to reveal my hot tip.
units.body: Heheh, time to reveal my hot tip.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Hope everyone’s ready for a scoop found by yours truly!
units.body: Hope everyone’s ready for a scoop found by yours truly!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: According to the map, the next car is the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>, where Sonic was stationed.
units.body: According to the map, the next car is the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>, where Sonic was stationed.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: This door, right here in the <style=CarName>lounge car</style>, is the only door that leads to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>. Following?
units.body: This door, right here in the <style=CarName>lounge car</style>, is the only door that leads to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>. Following?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: So Shadow was locking all the doors for one reason and one reason alone…
units.body: So Shadow was locking all the doors for one reason and one reason alone…

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: To keep Sonic… from escaping the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>!
units.body: To keep Sonic… from escaping the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: So you think Shadow… Was trapping Sonic?
units.body: So you think Shadow… Was trapping Sonic?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I sure do! He locked the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>, then locked all the others so one locked door wasn’t suspicious.
units.body: I sure do! He locked the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>, then locked all the others so one locked door wasn’t suspicious.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: Pure conjecture. You all, get out and leave me be.
units.body: Pure conjecture. You all, get out and leave me be.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Well, my source can back up these claims. They will remain anonymous, but I think the point stands.
units.body: Well, my source can back up these claims. They will remain anonymous, but I think the point stands.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: My source claims they never saw Sonic again after he went to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>. Why?
units.body: My source claims they never saw Sonic again after he went to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>. Why?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Because he was trapped… and couldn’t leave the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>!
units.body: Because he was trapped… and couldn’t leave the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Is the logic sound, though? Was Shadow… trapping Sonic?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Is the logic sound, though? Was Shadow… trapping Sonic?)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I’ll play along and follow this train of logic, Amy.
units.body: I’ll play along and follow this train of logic, Amy.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: If Shadow did lock the door to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style> imprisoning Sonic…
units.body: If Shadow did lock the door to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style> imprisoning Sonic…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …then how was Sonic found in the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?
units.body: …then how was Sonic found in the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?

units.original: ^ and I can explain the car change, however.
units.body: and I can explain the car change, however.

units.original: ^…? What evidence do we have that shows Sonic could have gotten to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?
units.body: …? What evidence do we have that shows Sonic could have gotten to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Hmm, I’m not quite sure this is right. Let's look for more evidence.
units.body: Hmm, I’m not quite sure this is right. Let's look for more evidence.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Ok! Just get my thoughts in order…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Ok! Just get my thoughts in order…)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(What piece of evidence shows how Sonic could have ended up at the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(What piece of evidence shows how Sonic could have ended up at the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?)</style>

units.original: ^ and I found a hidden passage in the wardrobe that leads right to the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
units.body: and I found a hidden passage in the wardrobe that leads right to the <style=CarName>library car</style>.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: So someone could have used the passage, snuck through the <style=CarName>library car</style>, walked past the distracted boys playing arcade…
units.body: So someone could have used the passage, snuck through the <style=CarName>library car</style>, walked past the distracted boys playing arcade…

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Hm. This adjusts my theory a bit.
units.body: Hm. This adjusts my theory a bit.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: So Shadow murdered Sonic in the <style=CarName>conductor car</style>, but then thought the crime scene being so close to his station was suspicious.
units.body: So Shadow murdered Sonic in the <style=CarName>conductor car</style>, but then thought the crime scene being so close to his station was suspicious.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Shadow picked up Sonic, locked the door to the <style=CarName>conductor car</style> on the way out, and dropped the body off at the <style=CarName>dining car</style>.
units.body: Shadow picked up Sonic, locked the door to the <style=CarName>conductor car</style> on the way out, and dropped the body off at the <style=CarName>dining car</style>.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Are you officially accusing Shadow of murder?
units.body: Are you officially accusing Shadow of murder?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I am! But of course, this is just a theory.
units.body: I am! But of course, this is just a theory.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I, uh, don’t have any evidence to back this up. Other than my hot scoop!
units.body: I, uh, don’t have any evidence to back this up. Other than my hot scoop!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Ha! Seems Tails and I were more thorough than you!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Ha! Seems Tails and I were more thorough than you!)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: If Shadow’s not going to talk, then I’ll humor you once again.
units.body: If Shadow’s not going to talk, then I’ll humor you once again.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: If Shadow traveled through the hidden passage and appeared in the <style=CarName>library car</style>…
units.body: If Shadow traveled through the hidden passage and appeared in the <style=CarName>library car</style>…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …then how did Espio and Vector not see him?
units.body: …then how did Espio and Vector not see him?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I suppose it would be hard to sneak around two people…
units.body: I suppose it would be hard to sneak around two people…

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Oh? Well… Espio and Vector didn’t see Shadow because...
units.body: Oh? Well… Espio and Vector didn’t see Shadow because...

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: That’s true, Vector was with Knuckles, and wouldn’t have seen Shadow enter the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
units.body: That’s true, Vector was with Knuckles, and wouldn’t have seen Shadow enter the <style=CarName>library car</style>.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: See! Things are falling into place.
units.body: See! Things are falling into place.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I believe Espio was behind a bookshelf at a table reading.
units.body: I believe Espio was behind a bookshelf at a table reading.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Espio reading in the library checks out, that’s what he told me too.
units.body: Espio reading in the library checks out, that’s what he told me too.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: When I completely obliterated Knuckles and Vector at that whatever game, I left the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
units.body: When I completely obliterated Knuckles and Vector at that whatever game, I left the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: I spent some time looking for Espio… but he was not there. He was not in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
units.body: I spent some time looking for Espio… but he was not there. He was not in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Like I’d believe you! You’re currently my number one suspect!
units.body: Like I’d believe you! You’re currently my number one suspect!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Why were you even searching for Espio, huh?
units.body: Why were you even searching for Espio, huh?

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: If you must know, I needed to give him a key.
units.body: If you must know, I needed to give him a key.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: As if! Why would a locksmith be giving away his keys?
units.body: As if! Why would a locksmith be giving away his keys?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Shadow has been giving away a lot of keys, actually. Everyone but us seems to have one.
units.body: Shadow has been giving away a lot of keys, actually. Everyone but us seems to have one.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: That’s true, everyone’s been able to unlock the next door for us.
units.body: That’s true, everyone’s been able to unlock the next door for us.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: …! I didn’t know that! Shadow’s been… passing out keys?
units.body: …! I didn’t know that! Shadow’s been… passing out keys?

units.original: ^ and I can further validate Shadow’s claims.
units.body: and I can further validate Shadow’s claims.

units.original: ^… What evidence supports Shadow’s claim that he was giving keys away?
units.body: … What evidence supports Shadow’s claim that he was giving keys away?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Hmm, I’m not quite sure this is right. Let's look for more evidence.
units.body: Hmm, I’m not quite sure this is right. Let's look for more evidence.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(That feels good, now to get my thoughts in order…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(That feels good, now to get my thoughts in order…)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(What piece of evidence helps show that Shadow was giving away his keys?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(What piece of evidence helps show that Shadow was giving away his keys?)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: There’s only one reason there’s exactly two keys on that keyring.
units.body: There’s only one reason there’s exactly two keys on that keyring.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Those were the two keys Shadow meant to give Espio and Vector.
units.body: Those were the two keys Shadow meant to give Espio and Vector.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: W-well, what of his own key? Couldn’t one of those be for him?
units.body: W-well, what of his own key? Couldn’t one of those be for him?

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: I have my own key on me.
units.body: I have my own key on me.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: So let’s say Shadow’s telling the truth, then what?
units.body: So let’s say Shadow’s telling the truth, then what?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: If Shadow didn’t murder Sonic and bring him to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>…
units.body: If Shadow didn’t murder Sonic and bring him to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>…

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Then what possible reason could he have for locking all the doors?
units.body: Then what possible reason could he have for locking all the doors?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(She’s right… Her theory is strong. Tails and I certainly haven’t presented any possibilities.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(She’s right… Her theory is strong. Tails and I certainly haven’t presented any possibilities.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Is Shadow… really innocent in Sonic’s murder?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Is Shadow… really innocent in Sonic’s murder?)</style>

units.original: ^ and I know exactly why Shadow was locking all the doors.
units.body: and I know exactly why Shadow was locking all the doors.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...! WHY DOES HE KEEP INCLUDING ME, TOO?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...! WHY DOES HE KEEP INCLUDING ME, TOO?)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: First, Amy, I just have one question for you.
units.body: First, Amy, I just have one question for you.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Has everyone today given you a <style=Important>birthday present</style>?
units.body: Has everyone today given you a <style=Important>birthday present</style>?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Oh, most everyone, yeah! Everyone’s been so sweet!
units.body: Oh, most everyone, yeah! Everyone’s been so sweet!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Just, um, Shadow and Sonic haven’t given me anything yet. But that’s ok! Just them being here is enough!
units.body: Just, um, Shadow and Sonic haven’t given me anything yet. But that’s ok! Just them being here is enough!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I have a theory, but I need a piece of evidence to support it.
units.body: I have a theory, but I need a piece of evidence to support it.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: We know Shadow walked through every train car locking the exits. And he gave everyone stationed in the cars a key.
units.body: We know Shadow walked through every train car locking the exits. And he gave everyone stationed in the cars a key.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...! That’s right, the conductor gave Amy her birthday key, not Shadow.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...! That’s right, the conductor gave Amy her birthday key, not Shadow.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(So… why would he lock all the doors and not give us a key?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(So… why would he lock all the doors and not give us a key?)</style>

units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Ah, shoot...that’s a good point. But Tails was on to something, I’m sure of it!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Ah, shoot...that’s a good point. But Tails was on to something, I’m sure of it!)</style>

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: I locked all the doors, and Espio didn’t have a key… he would have had to take the <style=Important>hidden passage</style> back.
units.body: I locked all the doors, and Espio didn’t have a key… he would have had to take the <style=Important>hidden passage</style> back.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.original: ^Blaze:: If he took the <style=Important>hidden passage</style> back, he’d end up back in the <style=CarName>library</style>.
units.body: If he took the <style=Important>hidden passage</style> back, he’d end up back in the <style=CarName>library</style>.

units.original: ^ and I know another way it could have been done.
units.body: and I know another way it could have been done.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: What piece of evidence do we need to take a closer look at?
units.body: What piece of evidence do we need to take a closer look at?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(I don’t think this is the right direction.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(I don’t think this is the right direction.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(What evidence shows another route Espio could have used to move Sonic?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(What evidence shows another route Espio could have used to move Sonic?)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: If Espio didn’t take the <style=Important>secret passage</style> to get to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>…
units.body: If Espio didn’t take the <style=Important>secret passage</style> to get to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …then what route did he take to get Sonic there?
units.body: …then what route did he take to get Sonic there?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: There's...there's a path above the <style=CarName>conductor car</style>! And it goes all the way to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>!
units.body: There's...there's a path above the <style=CarName>conductor car</style>! And it goes all the way to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>!

units.speaker: Rouge
units.original: ^Rouge:: Huh? I didn’t even see that area!
units.body: Huh? I didn’t even see that area!

units.speaker: Rouge
units.original: ^Rouge:: Is that some sort of… long attic?
units.body: Is that some sort of… long attic?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: According to these blueprints, there’s a hidden path in the ceiling that leads straight to the dining car.
units.body: According to these blueprints, there’s a hidden path in the ceiling that leads straight to the dining car.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: The vent, of course! That must be the entrance to the path.
units.body: The vent, of course! That must be the entrance to the path.

units.speaker: Knuckles
units.original: ^Knuckles:: Allow me to check it out.
units.body: Allow me to check it out.

units.speaker: Knuckles
units.original: ^Knuckles:: There is a path back there! And a track!
units.body: There is a path back there! And a track!

units.speaker: Knuckles
units.original: ^Knuckles:: A track for the robot arms, I think.
units.body: A track for the robot arms, I think.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: This must be the path the arms take to move throughout the train.
units.body: This must be the path the arms take to move throughout the train.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I somehow fit with Sonic in that vent, and took him to the dining car?
units.body: I somehow fit with Sonic in that vent, and took him to the dining car?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Tails, you’re a smart kid, so I know you realize we both couldn’t fit up there.
units.body: Tails, you’re a smart kid, so I know you realize we both couldn’t fit up there.

units.speaker: Knuckles
units.original: ^Knuckles:: Espio’s right. This is feeling flimsy, Tails.
units.body: Espio’s right. This is feeling flimsy, Tails.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I need an answer. My name’s getting dragged around here.
units.body: I need an answer. My name’s getting dragged around here.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: How on Earth would I get Sonic through that vent?
units.body: How on Earth would I get Sonic through that vent?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Phew, now to think about my argument.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Phew, now to think about my argument.)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(What could be used to carry Sonic through that vent?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(What could be used to carry Sonic through that vent?)</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Everyone saw the <style=InventoryItem>broken robot arm</style> on the ground, right?
units.body: Everyone saw the <style=InventoryItem>broken robot arm</style> on the ground, right?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Clearly, a fight broke out here, and one of these robot arms was a casualty.
units.body: Clearly, a fight broke out here, and one of these robot arms was a casualty.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: But what if… one of the robot arms actually caught Sonic?
units.body: But what if… one of the robot arms actually caught Sonic?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Knuckles said there’s a track the robot arms use that continues through the vent.
units.body: Knuckles said there’s a track the robot arms use that continues through the vent.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: A robot arm could have grabbed Sonic passed out from a <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style>…
units.body: A robot arm could have grabbed Sonic passed out from a <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style>…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Take a look at Sonic, he’s clearly banged up.
units.body: Take a look at Sonic, he’s clearly banged up.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Could the fight have been between Sonic and the robot arms?
units.body: Could the fight have been between Sonic and the robot arms?

units.speaker: Rouge
units.original: ^Rouge:: I can see that… Those arms do look powerful…
units.body: I can see that… Those arms do look powerful…

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: Sonic doesn’t fall easily… but if he’s woozy from a blowdart, the arms could have gotten him.
units.body: Sonic doesn’t fall easily… but if he’s woozy from a blowdart, the arms could have gotten him.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.original: ^Blaze:: Interesting theory, Tails… but you have to admit these are a lot of coincidences.
units.body: Interesting theory, Tails… but you have to admit these are a lot of coincidences.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I might not be able to link everything directly to Espio yet…
units.body: I might not be able to link everything directly to Espio yet…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Someone here received false information, and I believe that information… came from Espio.
units.body: Someone here received false information, and I believe that information… came from Espio.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Someone here received a hot scoop that turned out to be false. Who was it?
units.body: Someone here received a hot scoop that turned out to be false. Who was it?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Amy… you received a hot scoop, did you not?
units.body: Amy… you received a hot scoop, did you not?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: I think it’s time you told us where that scoop came from.
units.body: I think it’s time you told us where that scoop came from.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Espio told me Shadow was locking doors to trap Sonic…
units.body: Espio told me Shadow was locking doors to trap Sonic…

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy::…But we found out Shadow was trying to keep me from discovering my birthday surprise!
units.body: …But we found out Shadow was trying to keep me from discovering my birthday surprise!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: No, of course not. Amy must have misheard me.
units.body: No, of course not. Amy must have misheard me.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Y-yes, I said, uh, Sonic’s going to get trapped with all these locked doors!
units.body: Y-yes, I said, uh, Sonic’s going to get trapped with all these locked doors!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I was just looking out for my fellow passenger’s safety. I didn’t blame Shadow!
units.body: I was just looking out for my fellow passenger’s safety. I didn’t blame Shadow!

units.speaker: Blaze
units.original: ^Blaze:: The evidence might not be air tight… but there’s a lot being thrown at you that makes sense.
units.body: The evidence might not be air tight… but there’s a lot being thrown at you that makes sense.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: I have to agree. You want us to believe you were lazily reading the whole time?
units.body: I have to agree. You want us to believe you were lazily reading the whole time?

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: While you were stationed in the room with a <style=Important>hidden passage</style>?
units.body: While you were stationed in the room with a <style=Important>hidden passage</style>?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: And now you’re lying to me? On my birthday? Of all days?
units.body: And now you’re lying to me? On my birthday? Of all days?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I believe the murderer used the train’s controls to move Sonic from the conductor car to the dining car…
units.body: I believe the murderer used the train’s controls to move Sonic from the conductor car to the dining car…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …and lied to Amy casting further blame on Shadow. For no other reason than to cause doubt and confusion.
units.body: …and lied to Amy casting further blame on Shadow. For no other reason than to cause doubt and confusion.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: When examining everyone’s alibi’s, one clearly stands out as the weakest!
units.body: When examining everyone’s alibi’s, one clearly stands out as the weakest!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: I believe it’s clear to everyone…
units.body: I believe it’s clear to everyone…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: …that it only could have been one person!
units.body: …that it only could have been one person!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: You were the one who murdered Sonic The Hedgehog!
units.body: You were the one who murdered Sonic The Hedgehog!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Sonic…! And just as we solved the mystery!
units.body: Sonic…! And just as we solved the mystery!

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Espio jumped me in the <style=CarName>conductor car</style>.
units.body: Espio jumped me in the <style=CarName>conductor car</style>.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: <style=Flashback>"It’s nonlethal poison. You'll just be sleepy for a while."</style>
units.body: <style=Flashback>"It’s nonlethal poison. You'll just be sleepy for a while."</style>

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: Do you need to lie back down?
units.body: Do you need to lie back down?

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: N-No… We all need to get off this train.
units.body: N-No… We all need to get off this train.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: When I arrived at the conductor car, the conductor was already here.
units.body: When I arrived at the conductor car, the conductor was already here.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: He was so excited to tell me all about the features of the train.
units.body: He was so excited to tell me all about the features of the train.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: But what he was telling me… I had a bad feeling. I asked to see the power source. The conductor hadn’t even seen it.
units.body: But what he was telling me… I had a bad feeling. I asked to see the power source. The conductor hadn’t even seen it.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: When we took a look, we realized...
units.body: When we took a look, we realized...

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: There’s only one person twisted enough to use a flicky as a power source…
units.body: There’s only one person twisted enough to use a flicky as a power source…

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: I told the conductor the train needed to be destroyed… he refused.
units.body: I told the conductor the train needed to be destroyed… he refused.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: The way the conductor was describing it… it’s more than a simple badnik.
units.body: The way the conductor was describing it… it’s more than a simple badnik.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: It’s the conductor’s friend. The train is his co-conductor.
units.body: It’s the conductor’s friend. The train is his co-conductor.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(They uh, certainly didn’t tell me that in the interview…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(They uh, certainly didn’t tell me that in the interview…)</style>

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Right as we saw the <style=Important>flicky</style>, I felt a sting in my shoulder. It was the <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style> from Espio.
units.body: Right as we saw the <style=Important>flicky</style>, I felt a sting in my shoulder. It was the <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style> from Espio.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: The lights in the room started to glow red...
units.body: The lights in the room started to glow red...

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: I knew something was wrong and stood up.
units.body: I knew something was wrong and stood up.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: The arms came for me next.
units.body: The arms came for me next.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic::  I spindashed right through the robot arm, sliced it off the rail it was on.
units.body: I spindashed right through the robot arm, sliced it off the rail it was on.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Wow… <style=Thought>(I’m amazed he was able to do any of this poisoned!)</style>
units.body: Wow… <style=Thought>(I’m amazed he was able to do any of this poisoned!)</style>

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: But another robot arm managed to grab me, and pinned me to the floor.
units.body: But another robot arm managed to grab me, and pinned me to the floor.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: The Conductor screamed as the arms approached him, but…
units.body: The Conductor screamed as the arms approached him, but…

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: …I was hit quite a bit before it all got to me…
units.body: …I was hit quite a bit before it all got to me…

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: Everyone… I have something to admit.
units.body: Everyone… I have something to admit.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: The situation has gotten so serious… Why would you not just tell us?
units.body: The situation has gotten so serious… Why would you not just tell us?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I thought that's how these murder games worked.
units.body: I thought that's how these murder games worked.

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: You shoot someone with a <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style>, they die!
units.body: You shoot someone with a <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style>, they die!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Are you crazy?? It's just a make-believe game, no one should get hit with a <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style>!!
units.body: Are you crazy?? It's just a make-believe game, no one should get hit with a <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style>!!

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I was just following the rules.
units.body: I was just following the rules.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: It says… “Use this <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style> on Sonic, stationed in the conductor car. It is laced with a nonlethal sleeping agent.”
units.body: It says… “Use this <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style> on Sonic, stationed in the conductor car. It is laced with a nonlethal sleeping agent.”

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: “Thank you again for choosing the Mirage Express...-Staff.”
units.body: “Thank you again for choosing the Mirage Express...-Staff.”

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: I was given the <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style> along with that card.
units.body: I was given the <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style> along with that card.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: It’s signed staff… Who gave this to you?
units.body: It’s signed staff… Who gave this to you?

units.speaker: Espio
units.original: ^Espio:: …one of the <style=Important>robotic arms</style> handed it to me.
units.body: …one of the <style=Important>robotic arms</style> handed it to me.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Weapons shouldn’t be allowed on the train…
units.body: Weapons shouldn’t be allowed on the train…

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: What is the larger picture here…? Who instructed those arms to attack?
units.body: What is the larger picture here…? Who instructed those arms to attack?

units.original: ^, who do you think attacked Sonic and handed Espio the <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style>?
units.body: , who do you think attacked Sonic and handed Espio the <style=InventoryItem>blowdart</style>?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: According to Sonic, the conductor was attacked by the <style=Important>robot arms.</style>
units.body: According to Sonic, the conductor was attacked by the <style=Important>robot arms.</style>

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I doubt he attacked himself on purpose, and while it could have been an accident, I have a different theory…
units.body: I doubt he attacked himself on purpose, and while it could have been an accident, I have a different theory…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I believe something’s been orchestrating things behind the scenes.
units.body: I believe something’s been orchestrating things behind the scenes.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Something wanted Sonic out of the picture, and for a good while. So I think…
units.body: Something wanted Sonic out of the picture, and for a good while. So I think…

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(First we learn the train’s a badnik… and now it’s out to get us?!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(First we learn the train’s a badnik… and now it’s out to get us?!)</style>

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: Once again you keep saying the most ridiculous nonsense.
units.body: Once again you keep saying the most ridiculous nonsense.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: You’re seriously convinced the train has it out to get us?
units.body: You’re seriously convinced the train has it out to get us?

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I don’t know what the train’s full intent is…
units.body: I don’t know what the train’s full intent is…

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: But clearly it’s been tampering in our murder mystery game!
units.body: But clearly it’s been tampering in our murder mystery game!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: It’s my BIRTHDAY! And I don’t need you MESSING WITH IT!
units.body: It’s my BIRTHDAY! And I don’t need you MESSING WITH IT!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Amy’s hitting the wall with her hammer!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Amy’s hitting the wall with her hammer!)</style>

units.speaker: Vector
units.original: ^Vector:: I’m with you, Amy. This train can have it!
units.body: I’m with you, Amy. This train can have it!

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: C’mon, there’s gotta be another way to get the train’s attention!
units.body: C’mon, there’s gotta be another way to get the train’s attention!

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Here, I can get him down–
units.body: Here, I can get him down–

units.speaker: Train
units.original: ^Train:: Of course I can talk! You fools were too distracted playing your little game to figure it out.
units.body: Of course I can talk! You fools were too distracted playing your little game to figure it out.

units.speaker: Train
units.original: ^Train:: I’m taking all of you to Eggman’s BASE.
units.body: I’m taking all of you to Eggman’s BASE.

units.speaker: Train
units.original: ^Train:: After I deliver your annoying party right to his egg fortress…
units.body: After I deliver your annoying party right to his egg fortress…

units.speaker: Train
units.original: ^Train:: THE CONDUCTOR AND I will be free to laugh and play games… Ride the open rails … Like we always planned!
units.body: THE CONDUCTOR AND I will be free to laugh and play games… Ride the open rails … Like we always planned!

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Which one of these buttons turns the train off?!
units.body: Which one of these buttons turns the train off?!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Y’know, I’m alright. I don’t need to check the trash bin.
units.body: Y’know, I’m alright. I don’t need to check the trash bin.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: You’re satisfied with finding a clue here before, huh?
units.body: You’re satisfied with finding a clue here before, huh?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: I know they say “always check the trash bin,” but I’m good. I’ll go out on a high note.
units.body: I know they say “always check the trash bin,” but I’m good. I’ll go out on a high note.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: No no they’re right, you should always check the trash bin.
units.body: No no they’re right, you should always check the trash bin.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: You gave in so easily! Will you be ok if there’s nothing in there?
units.body: You gave in so easily! Will you be ok if there’s nothing in there?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: I found something once, no one can take that away from me. I’ll be fine.
units.body: I found something once, no one can take that away from me. I’ll be fine.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: Oh no… you look so sad about it.
units.body: Oh no… you look so sad about it.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: You two have been talking over the trash can for awhile now.
units.body: You two have been talking over the trash can for awhile now.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Yeah, I wanna see! Is it a clue?
units.body: Yeah, I wanna see! Is it a clue?

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I’ve noticed these screens throughout the entire train.
units.body: I’ve noticed these screens throughout the entire train.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Yeah, they’re used to show information and advertisements.
units.body: Yeah, they’re used to show information and advertisements.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: They’re nice, the picture is really clear. I would watch a full movie on one!
units.body: They’re nice, the picture is really clear. I would watch a full movie on one!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I saw a slide that said ‘Happy Birthday Amy!’ That was so cute.
units.body: I saw a slide that said ‘Happy Birthday Amy!’ That was so cute.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: …the next ad being for nasal medication was a little jarring, though.
units.body: …the next ad being for nasal medication was a little jarring, though.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: The high quality screens probably didn’t do that ad any favors…
units.body: The high quality screens probably didn’t do that ad any favors…

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Not at all. Perhaps too much detail.
units.body: Not at all. Perhaps too much detail.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Wow, the conductor looks so young in his uniform!
units.body: Wow, the conductor looks so young in his uniform!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: He’s been here a long time, after thirty-two years he told me he’s finally retiring.
units.body: He’s been here a long time, after thirty-two years he told me he’s finally retiring.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: He said he's headed to Spagonia with his wife, I hope they have a great trip!
units.body: He said he's headed to Spagonia with his wife, I hope they have a great trip!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Thirty-two years is a long time, I wish them a lot of happiness!
units.body: Thirty-two years is a long time, I wish them a lot of happiness!

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: May any future sorrow be fleeting.
units.body: May any future sorrow be fleeting.

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: Uh, yes, I wish that too!
units.body: Uh, yes, I wish that too!

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: I didn’t realize these robot arms could also drive the train.
units.body: I didn’t realize these robot arms could also drive the train.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Yeah! But they can’t access every function on the train like the conductor can.
units.body: Yeah! But they can’t access every function on the train like the conductor can.

units.speaker: Shadow
units.original: ^Shadow:: Did they teach you how to drive it?
units.body: Did they teach you how to drive it?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Oh… no, just how to work the microwave.
units.body: Oh… no, just how to work the microwave.

units.speaker: Tails
units.original: ^Tails:: I recognize some of these functions, maybe I could drive the train!
units.body: I recognize some of these functions, maybe I could drive the train!

units.speaker: Amy
units.original: ^Amy:: I would completely trust you to drive the train.
units.body: I would completely trust you to drive the train.

units.speaker: Shadow

units.body: The <style=Important>robotic arms</style> can also detect weapons or explosives being brought onto the train, ensuring passenger safety.

units.body: That's the spirit! Let's go find our friends!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: To the conductor car, to end this mystery!
units.body: To the conductor car, to end this mystery!

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Ready to go save our friends?
units.body: Ready to go save our friends?

units.original: ^Uhhh sorry I need just a little more time
units.body: Uhhh sorry I need just a little more time

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: To the conductor car, to end this mystery!
units.body: To the conductor car, to end this mystery!

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Do what you gotta do, then let's get out of here!
units.body: Do what you gotta do, then let's get out of here!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(Wow... So Eggman built this train, huh?)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Wow... So Eggman built this train, huh?)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...No sense dwelling on it now... We know what we have to do!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...No sense dwelling on it now... We know what we have to do!)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: My goodness, this door is daunting.
units.body: My goodness, this door is daunting.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: The train’s doing everything it can to keep us from the conductor car…
units.body: The train’s doing everything it can to keep us from the conductor car…

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Let me see if a spindash can’t solve all our problems.
units.body: Let me see if a spindash can’t solve all our problems.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Ah…! It’ll take more than a few hits to get through…
units.body: Ah…! It’ll take more than a few hits to get through…

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Let's take it easy for now and keep looking around. There must be another way to open this door.
units.body: Let's take it easy for now and keep looking around. There must be another way to open this door.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Like a switch! Classic door opening mechanism.
units.body: Like a switch! Classic door opening mechanism.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: <style=Thought>(...what doors are you using that require a switch??!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(...what doors are you using that require a switch??!)</style>

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: The windows are all covered up now… I never got to look at the pretty views…
units.body: The windows are all covered up now… I never got to look at the pretty views…

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Amy was saying the train’s sights couldn’t be beat! I was excited!
units.body: Amy was saying the train’s sights couldn’t be beat! I was excited!

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: After all we’ve been through, I’m sure the train company will offer you some kind of coupon for another visit.
units.body: After all we’ve been through, I’m sure the train company will offer you some kind of coupon for another visit.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: …! That’d be great, as I still don’t know where my wallet is…
units.body: …! That’d be great, as I still don’t know where my wallet is…

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Ah, what a mess in here…
units.body: Ah, what a mess in here…

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: With the robot arms going rogue, I wonder who will have to pick all this up…
units.body: With the robot arms going rogue, I wonder who will have to pick all this up…

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Look at all this salt that’s spilled, no wonder you’re having bad luck.
units.body: Look at all this salt that’s spilled, no wonder you’re having bad luck.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Quick, pick some up and toss it over your shoulder.
units.body: Quick, pick some up and toss it over your shoulder.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: O-ok! <style=Thought>(A pinch of salt and… there, over the shoulder.)</style>
units.body: O-ok! <style=Thought>(A pinch of salt and… there, over the shoulder.)</style>

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Perfect, I can already tell our luck is turning around.
units.body: Perfect, I can already tell our luck is turning around.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Y-yeah, I guess you’re right! <style=Thought>(Why do I actually feel calmer…)</style>
units.body: Y-yeah, I guess you’re right! <style=Thought>(Why do I actually feel calmer…)</style>

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: The Conductor and I found Vector’s ticket in this napkin holder.
units.body: The Conductor and I found Vector’s ticket in this napkin holder.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: …? What was his ticket doing here?
units.body: …? What was his ticket doing here?

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Maybe he confused a napkin for his ticket, and his ticket for a napkin?
units.body: Maybe he confused a napkin for his ticket, and his ticket for a napkin?

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: HA, hope his ticket didn’t have a ketchup stain.
units.body: HA, hope his ticket didn’t have a ketchup stain.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: …! Hey, one of those robotic arms are here too–
units.body: …! Hey, one of those robotic arms are here too–

units.speaker: Sonic
units.original: ^Sonic:: Best to leave it alone. The train’s definitely mad at us.
units.body: Best to leave it alone. The train’s definitely mad at us.

units.speaker: Barry
units.original: ^Barry:: Good call. <style=Thought>(We gotta get out of here before that arm swipes at us again…)</style>
units.body: Good call. <style=Thought>(We gotta get out of here before that arm swipes at us again…)</style>

units.speaker: NamelessMC
units.original: ^NamelessMC::<style=Thought>(Phew, made it on the train fifteen minutes ahead of schedule.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Phew, made it on the train fifteen minutes ahead of schedule.)</style>

units.speaker: NamelessMC
units.original: ^NamelessMC::<style=Thought>(So far so good for my first day on the job!)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(So far so good for my first day on the job!)</style>

units.speaker: NamelessMC
units.original: ^NamelessMC::<style=Thought>(Oh… I totally forgot my nametag isn’t ready yet. I should make one…)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(Oh… I totally forgot my nametag isn’t ready yet. I should make one…)</style>

units.original: ^If you see this line, something's gone wrong
units.body: If you see this line, something's gone wrong

units.speaker: NamelessMC
units.original: ^NamelessMC::<style=Thought>(I don't think I could show my face around here again if I wrote that.)</style>
units.body: <style=Thought>(I don't think I could show my face around here again if I wrote that.)</style>

units.original: An overhead map of the layout of the Library, shelves and tables included.
A blowdart found on the floor in the conductor’s car. No dart board nearby though… suspicious.
Amy's trusty hammer! It's great for all kinds of things from punting Eggman to mounting picture frames.
A lock that supposedly Shadow has been placing on multiple doors of the train.
A Super Monkey Ball arcade machine completely smashed up. It's a shame to see Super Monkey Ball in this state.
Shadow’s keyring with two dangling keys. I always thought a locksmith would have more keys than that.
Used cups sitting on the Saloon Car’s bar. One cup has a lipstick mark on the rim.
An exhaustive manual of the Mirage Express’ many features and capabilities. Doesn’t seem to mention how to drive the train, which would've been neat.
Some sort of stick. On closer inspection, could it also be a handle?
So sad to see a ticket alone and confused like this… We’ll return it, I have faith.
The Mirage Express dining menu. It features ‘chili dog‘, ‘instant ramen’ and ‘chicken cordon bleu.’
The cord to a robotic arm is completely sliced through. I humored the idea of an ax causing this, but weapons aren’t allowed on the train.
A large chunk of a bookcase is missing. Odd.
Pulling a string in the wardrobe revealed a hidden passage! Upon inspection, it leads from the lounge to the library.
Blueprints showcasing the full layout and specifications of each car on the train, including the hidden passage. A code to the safe is handwritten in the corner.
Ball of paper found in the trash bin… I kinda want to see what it is.
